title: Slow-Cooked Beef Casserole
steps: Cut the beef chuck steak into 4 cm chunks and season well with salt and pepper. Heat a splash of olive oil in a large heavy-based pot over high heat and brown the beef in batches, setting each batch aside as it colours.

Turn the heat down to medium. Roughly chop the brown onions and celery, add them to the pot and cook for 5 minutes until soft, scraping up the browned bits from the base. Crush in the garlic and cook for 1 minute more.
Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute until it darkens a shade.

Return the beef and any resting juices to the pot. Pour in the crushed tomatoes and gluten-free beef stock, drop in the thyme sprigs and 2 bay leaves, and add a splash of water to loosen. Bring to a gentle simmer.
Cover and cook on the lowest heat for 2 hours, giving it a stir every now and then.
Cut the carrots into thick chunks and halve the baby potatoes. Stir them into the pot, cover again and cook for another hour, until the beef pulls apart with a fork and the potatoes are tender.

Mix the gluten free cornflour with 2 tablespoons of cold water to make a slurry. Trim and halve the green beans. Stir both through the casserole and simmer uncovered for 10 minutes until the sauce thickens and the beans are just tender.
Fish out the thyme stalks and bay leaves, season to taste with salt and pepper, and scatter over the chopped fresh parsley to serve.
